# Set up Kiro roles

Use [Kiro dispatch](../../helix/references/kiro.md) to identify the CLI generation
and current agent schema. Read its native model catalog and supported effort
choices. Do not extend the Codex/Claude discovery script by guessing Kiro flags.

Show existing settings and ask only for missing model, effort and scope choices.
Use task-scoped flags for one-off choices. For persistent roles, follow Kiro's
current custom-agent configuration; preview the exact changes before saving.
Preserve unrelated resources, tools and permissions.

Include repository instructions and skill resources explicitly for custom agents.
A reviewer needs read tools and restricted paths. Tool trust is preapproval,
not a sandbox. Do not save broad trust to make an unattended run easier.

Read back settings and use the installed CLI's validation or agent listing.
Report saved configuration separately from a successful model execution. If
required capabilities are unavailable, leave settings unchanged and explain it.
